budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net increase in new revenue is nearly $430,000, of which $145,000 comes from new growth calculated by the assessor.
budget_items.quote: net increase new revenue is nearly $430,000.

budget_items.topic: State aid increase and Chapter 40S aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net increase in state aid in the Governor's budget is nearly $225,000, including $116,000 Chapter 40S aid, a non-recurring revenue the Town cannot count on going forward.
budget_items.quote: net increase in state aid in the governor's new budget is nearly $225,000.

budget_items.topic: Chapter 40S grant set to equal expenditures
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Superintendent Calmes identified $116,000 of non-recurring expenditures, so the 40S grant was set at $116,000.
budget_items.quote: superintendent calmes identified $116,000 of these, so kerry set the 40s grant at $116,000 to equal the amount of expenditures.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net changes in available funds account for the rest of the revenue increase.
budget_items.quote: net changes in available funds account for the rest of the increase-about $60,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net increases in expenditures are about $300,000, leaving a net surplus of nearly $130,000, slightly over 0.4% of the omnibus budget.
budget_items.quote: the net surplus (increased revenues less increased expenditures) is nearly $130,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Stormwater compliance, which is mandated at an unspecified date, may cost $250,000 to $500,000; proposed earmark of surplus funds.
budget_items.quote: compliance, which is mandated, may cost $250,000 to $500,000.

budget_items.topic: Snow and ice removal account history
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Snow and ice removal exceeded $300,000 in eight of the last ten years, averaging $311,384; in the last five years it averaged $354,539 (excluding winter 2014-15).
budget_items.quote: the average expenditure over that period was $311,384.

budget_items.topic: Snow and ice removal five-year average
budget_items.what_was_recorded: In each of the last five years snow and ice removal cost over $300,000, averaging $354,539.
budget_items.quote: in each of the last five years snow and ice removal cost over $300,000, and the average was $354,539.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Actual snow and ice spending regularly exceeds budget by several tens of thousands of dollars.

budget_items.quote: actual spending for snow and ice removal regularly exceeds the budget by several tens of thousands of dollars
